Typography
System

From expressive headlines to compact data, maintain one consistent visual voice. Four weights, type scale, and tokens create a flexible system for brand and product experiences.

Design Space

Four weights—Regular 400, Medium 500, SemiBold 600, and Bold 700—support clear reading, considered emphasis, and distinctive headlines. Use these defined weights consistently across design and implementation.

Weights Usage

Each weight has a clear responsibility—from supporting copy and body text to interaction labels, critical data, and expressive display headlines.

Usage Readability

Size, line height, weight, and line length must work together. These boundaries keep English content readable across brand communications and product interfaces.

  1. Use at least 14px for product body copy; default to 16px / 24px.
  2. Keep body line height between 1.4× and 1.6× the font size.
  3. Limit continuous text to 45–75 English characters per line.
  4. Reserve all caps for buttons, navigation, and short status labels.
  1. Do not use body text below 14px in product interfaces.
  2. Avoid line heights below 1.2× or above 1.8× the font size.
  3. Do not set long paragraphs in all caps or heavy weights.
  4. Avoid overly long lines, extreme tracking, or centered body copy.
